trackedSponsoredCount.description: Bills in the 119th Congress that BillBoard tracks and this member sponsored, from BillBoard's own member stats (billsSponsored), not Congress.gov career totals. Absent, with the other two counts, when the member has no 119th counts (no tracked 119th bill, as for every member new in the 120th Congress, whose stats row then holds counts of later Congresses only) or the stats could not be read; a member with 119th counts gets them, zeros included. Always the 119th Congress's: currentCongressCounts carries the newest Congress's.

trackedSupportedCount.description: Bills in the 119th Congress that BillBoard tracks and this member cosponsored, from BillBoard's own member stats (billsSupported), not Congress.gov career totals. Absent, with the other two counts, when the member has no 119th counts (no tracked 119th bill, as for every member new in the 120th Congress, whose stats row then holds counts of later Congresses only) or the stats could not be read; a member with 119th counts gets them, zeros included. Always the 119th Congress's: currentCongressCounts carries the newest Congress's.

congressCounts.title: CongressMemberCongressCountsV1
congressCounts.description: A member's counts for one Congress, from BillBoard's own member stats, which count each Congress apart (REL-46): the newest Congress the member has counts in, else the 119th. Absent when the member has no counts or the stats could not be read. Clients label the counts with this congress, never with one computed from a date.

congress.description: The Congress the counts cover, such as 120.

sponsored.description: Bills of that Congress that BillBoard tracks and this member sponsored.

supported.description: Bills of that Congress that BillBoard tracks and this member cosponsored.
